710440501.text: Could you tell me more about The Chasm?

710440502.text: Right, so about the Chasm... If you don't intend to leave just yet, you're free to explore the area a bit. But please do keep your actions within the remit of Liyue's laws and statutes.

710440503.text: I should mention, though, that there is a place that I highly recommend you avoid.

710440504.text: For example, the great mine in the center of The Chasm has had a Seven-Star Array cast over it... By which I mean exactly what I say — it is a seal placed over the area by the Qixing.

710440505.text: Well, that's quite the clear explanation.

710440506.text: As for the weak... I mean, focal point of the array, it lies in the Bedrock Keys surrounding the area. These were placed by the Qixing themselves. Connected in series, they affix the energy flowing through the array.

710440507.text: The area around the Bedrock Keys has seen an abnormal amount of Geo elemental coalescences. It's almost as if the "thing" beneath yearns to finally emerge...

710440508.text: ...Uh, never mind me, I was just talking to myself. So yes, that's how things are. Please do not — and I repeat, do not — go near the Seven-Star Array, and don't even think about going down there to explore.

710440509.text: The Bedrock Keys are definitely not losing structural integrity, and the surrounding areas are most certainly not plagued by any strange Geo elemental convergences. So please, don't you think of doing anything at all.

710440511.text: Hmph, I know what you're going to ask.

710440512.text: There are most certainly no precious treasures down there, nor are there any prehistoric fossils to be had. And banish any thoughts you have about giant ancient ruins... Yes, please do not bear any fruitless expectations toward this place.

710440513.text: The way you're saying all this is super suspicious!

710440514.text: Not even mushrooms will grow down there! Nor are there wish-granting stones! And there are definitely no sailors who grow strong just by eating mushrooms! Again, do not get your hopes up!

710440515.text: Uh, yeah, sure! There's no need to be so fierce...

710440520.text: I suggest that you go speak to Zhiqiong first. She is an adventurer hired by the Ministry and was once a miner here. She knows The Chasm's geography like the back of her hand...

710440521.text: Also, let me write you a certification real quick. When she sees it, she'll know that you're trustworthy.

710440522.text: That said, I must warn you that Zhiqiong is definitely not the sort of person who has trouble standing still, and definitely has no thoughts of undoing the array and having a look underground.

710440523.text: So there's no way that she would ever put a team of idle adventurers together to brazenly enter hazardous areas! As such, you can forget about asking her to help you enter The Chasm's mines.

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to Muning and find out the situation in The Chasm

710440601.text: Huh, so there are stories about us too...

710440602.text: Of course! They are very popular in the city, you know? If you ask me, I'd say that Tea Master Liu Su and Iron Tongue Tian are both good in their own way, but I just prefer Iron...

710440605.text: Oh, don't worry, I get it, I get it. Iron Tongue Tian's style is definitely not for everyone. I do sometimes find that his choice of words and phrases features too much slang...

710440606.text: But as for Liu Su... He takes a while to get going, you know? Sometimes, you're there for two hours before you start going "oh hey, this is pretty good!" Some people like that style, but I find it uninteresting...

710440607.text: And if you mean to say that "this is just a story, it won't get stale," let me just say this — if this were food or drink we were talking about, it would surely go bad if we wrapped it up and covered it for half a day without opening it up...

710440707.text: Huh? That... shouldn't be the case. When I was guarding the place, the Treasure Hoarders wouldn't even dare come near it.

710440708.text: ...Wait a moment. Who did you say was guarding the warehouse, again?

710440710.text: Well, are you guarding it right now?

710440711.text: Well, come on now. Which adventurer in their right mind would let themselves get tied down with such a boring task, am I right?

710440706.text: And even they were wondering why no one was guarding the place!

710440801.text: Huh, you destroy— I mean, undid the bindings on the Bedrock Key so easily! Guess we were right to put our faith in you two!

710440804.text: Eh, Muning has already sent a damage report ahead of us. So technically, the Bedrock Keys were damaged *before* we arrived, not after.

710440805.text: Well, that leaves four more that we need to handle. Ah, yes, I've drawn a basic diagram that shows where three of the four are. I hope it'll be of use to you.

710440806.text: As for the last one... Honestly, I'm not very sure where that is anymore. After the miners were dismissed, there was a seepage incident in that mine, causing the cylinder to be submerged under the waters...

710440807.text: In any case, just settle the other three sites. We'll meet up after that and think about what to do next...

710440809.text: Not this time... I mean, I was originally assigned to guard the warehouse, but thanks to my slip-up, I nearly let the Treasure Hoarders in there. Honestly, I'm already in your debt for not reporting my error...

710440810.text: Things could get bad if Muning catches me and puts me on the trail of some errands again, so I'll just stand guard as I should... For now.

710440811.text: Still, I believe that this riddle will be no match for the two of you at all!

subQuests.subQuestName: Tell Zhiqiong about what happened at the warehouse
Look for a way to destroy the Bedrock Keys

710441302.text: Muning was the one who introduced me. This is his...

710441303.text: Yes, yes, forget that sheet of paper. I already know who you are just fine!

710441304.text: That Muning... All he does is put on airs and write papers. Everything's gotta follow this or that procedure and all that tripe. You know, stuff that makes you look important. I couldn't care less for that stuff...

710441305.text: In any case, your name is already well-known throughout the Adventurers' Guild, never mind any of your other contributions to Liyue.

710441309.text: Of course, many new recruits at the Guild have heard of your exploits on Dragonspine from Iris. Hehe, that includes me, you know?

710441310.text: Piercing the frigid blizzard to open a path, discovering an ancient, forgotten kingdom beneath the ice and frost, reaching the perilous summit, confronting the great change that came over that place with a mortal form...

710441311.text: The things you've experienced, the obstacles you've overcome, the truths you've uncovered... They can be summed up in one word: adventure! True adventure!

710441308.text: #That's right! We're the legendary duo — {NICKNAME} and Paimon!

subQuests.subQuestName: Use the cage-shaped object to destroy the three remaining Bedrock Keys

710441402.text: Muning was the one who introduced me. This is his...

710441403.text: Yes, yes, forget that sheet of paper. I already know who you are just fine!

710441404.text: That Muning... All he does is put on airs and write papers. Everything's gotta follow this or that procedure and all that tripe. You know, stuff that makes you look important. I couldn't care less for that stuff...

710441405.text: In any case, your name is already well-known throughout the Adventurers' Guild, never mind any of your other contributions to Liyue.

710441409.text: Haha! I mean, you had that great battle with that sea monster on the Jade Chamber. Now, I wasn't there to witness the event, mind you, but I haven't missed a single telling of that story!

710441408.text: #That's right! We're the legendary duo — {NICKNAME} and Paimon!

710441501.text: Don't worry, I won't run off. Just retrieve the Lumenstone Adjuvant, and things should go fine.

subQuests.subQuestName: Use the cage-shaped object to destroy the three remaining Bedrock Keys

710441601.text: Honestly, I'm not too sure about how the Bedrock Key works, but you could start from looking into those cage-shaped Geo elemental formations over there.

710441603.text: These strange formations have been puzzling the Ministry of Civil Affairs for some time now. They seem to have grown up from the bedrock of The Chasm over the last two years, and their properties are very similar to those of the "thing" underground.

710441604.text: We say this because they can undergo some kind of disintegration when under the influence of the anomalies.

710441605.text: Later, Huishan Hall's investigations revealed that they have been absorbing Geo elemental energy from the surroundings, slowly eroding the structure of the Bedrock Keys...

710441606.text: It is a most ominous phenomenon, almost like something is consciously trying to break the sealing array.

710441607.text: We have to clear them out twice every month, but they will always grow back quickly... and they have only grown back quicker over time.

710441608.text: Perhaps that "thing" below is growing restless... and that is why the Qixing has sent us to investigate.

710441701.text: Please don't talk to me for the time being, or I'll get in trouble again...

subQuests.subQuestName: Use the cage-shaped object to destroy the three remaining Bedrock Keys

710441801.text: Very impressive! That should be the last one. With this, the array sealing The Chasm has dissipated, and we can explore the area underground.

710441802.text: That said... We should probably go and pay Muning a visit first. Hmph, not that he's going to do anything other than scold us, though.

710441901.text: See? What did I say? You weren't guarding the warehouse as you should've at all!

710441902.text: You've really done it this time, Zhiqiong. How are we going to resolve this matter, huh? Are you going to take responsibility for undoing the array of your own accord? Can you?

710441903.text: Ah, you're here. *sigh* So... how are you going to explain destroying the Bedrock Keys?

710441906.text: You...! Ugh, alright! You're taking responsibility for this. As for the rest, we'll wait for the Qixing to make their judgment first.

710441907.text: Hehe, don't you worry, Muning only gets mad at people who don't care. Otherwise, he's just a worrywart — not a bad person.

710441908.text: Well, let's leave his stubborn temper aside first. Once you're ready, I'll round everyone up to follow you down into the mines.

710441918.text: Our purpose this time is to reach the deepest level of The Chasm, map it, and... uh, investigate the source of the anomalies.

710441909.text: Ah, yes, I almost forgot — welcome to the Chasm Exploration Team!

710441910.text: If you'll allow me a bit of your time, let me introduce you to the team.

710441911.text: This is Khedive, a scholar specifically called in from Sumeru. His specialties are ores and biology. He's this exploration team's leading man... well, in scientific and financial matters, at least.

710441912.text: This is Jinwu, who's in charge of safety. The repair and maintenance of any facilities we use and our security is ensured by her.

710441913.text: And this is... Taliesin. He's a bard from Mondstadt... and goodness knows why he insisted on coming down here with us.

710441914.text: Also, perhaps you'll discover new allies once you get down into the mines, eh? Haha, who knows?

710441915.text: And last but not least, you have me, the super hands-on surveyor! My job is to help scout the way forward and draw maps, which I'll share with you all, of course!

710441916.text: Well, please head over to the crane by the mines once you're ready. Originally, it was meant to transport goods, but it can also bring a few people up and down the mines, no problem!

710441917.text: Hmm, that said, since you have your wind glider, I suppose that you'd be fine even without the crane, eh?

710442001.text: If you understood what I said at all, please stop hanging around this place.

710442004.text: *sigh* If not nothing, really. All I can do is write weekly reports.

710442006.text: Just a somewhat bothersome, meaningless, but nonetheless necessary document.

710442007.text: Why don't you just stop writing them?

710442008.text: That won't do. I have to at least inform people that you've shown up here, you know?

710442009.text: The last report was sent out yesterday. In other words, the Ministry of Civil Affairs should get word of your presence here in a couple of days.

710442010.text: When that happens, someone might actually drop by and forcibly get you to leave.

710442011.text: So you're free to act before then, got it?

710442013.text: That's good. Hmph, if it wasn't for your great deeds in Liyue's service... Eh, you know what? Forget it.

subQuests.subQuestName: Report the destruction of the Bedrock Keys to Zhiqiong

710440901.text: We're back! The three Bedrock Keys have all been destroyed.

710440907.text: Don't start! It's nothing much... just the earth shaking, that's all. Perhaps the mountain rocks are being destabilized by the loosening of the seal... Do you feel it?

subQuests.subQuestName: Look for the final Bedrock Key
Look for the final Bedrock Key
